name: Apify
summary: Run scrapers from the Apify Store.
description: Apify's hosted server finds and runs Actors — ready-made scrapers and automations — and returns their datasets.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (console-backend.apify.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
